content.text: {"headline":"The spreadsheet stopped 231 days ago: 7 rows, only 5 contactable emails.","claim":"You can hand over 7 complete, unique rows; 5 of 7 emails are contactable, 2 are malformed, and the newest \"joined\" date is 231 days old.","risk":"If used as-is, 2 of 7 emails bounce and the recipient gets a list whose \"joined\" column stopped 231 days ago.","steps":["Fix or remove the 2 malformed addresses in \"email\" before handing over the list.","Rebuild the capture flow behind \"joined\"; its newest entry is 231 days old."]}
